# post_raw_body — POST with a raw NDJSON-shaped body, pagination.none
# Boots the post_raw_body scenario, runs one drain, and asserts the
# events JSONL and redacted trace JSONL match the golden.
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml post_raw_body
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"POST","request_body":"body 38 bytes, object-like","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>","Content-Type":"application/x-ndjson"},"response_body":"body 348 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/post_raw_body/ingest"}
-- want_events.jsonl --
{"id":"evt-000001","seq_num":1,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
{"id":"evt-000002","seq_num":2,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:01Z"}
{"id":"evt-000003","seq_num":3,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:02Z"}
{"id":"evt-000004","seq_num":4,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:03Z"}
{"id":"evt-000005","seq_num":5,"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:04Z"}
